tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground in every app. Warm off-white by day, deep hull by night. Never pure white or pure black.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the Dock, table rows on hover. Separated from paper by hairline, not by shadow.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset wells: input fields, code, the ground behind a page's content area when the Dock is expanded.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every border and rule: cards, table rows, inputs, the Dock edge. 1px, never thicker.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning (default input border, dividers between major regions). Meets 3:1 on paper in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunken. Also the ring and waterline of the marks when set in one ink.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, helper copy, table meta. Reads 5:1+ on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels and decorative icons only. Below 4.5:1 by design; never for text that must be read.

tokens.name: sea
tokens.usage: The company color shared by all three apps: primary buttons, links, active navigation, focus rings, the ring and waterline of every mark. As text it reads 8:1 on paper by day and 8:1 by night.

tokens.name: on-sea
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a sea fill (primary button label).

tokens.name: sea-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the active Dock tile's ground, info callouts. Never as text.

tokens.name: koi
tokens.usage: Coifish's accent: its mark, its Dock tile when active, its app-bar underline. Fills and strokes only; never put text on it (use the -deep token for text).

tokens.name: koi-deep
tokens.usage: Coifish's accent as text or icon on paper (5:1+). Use for in-app highlights that must be read, like an overdue certificate count.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: ReelMinder's accent: its mark, its Dock tile when active, its app-bar underline. Fills and strokes only; never put text on it (use the -deep token for text).

tokens.name: brass-deep
tokens.usage: ReelMinder's accent as text or icon on paper (5:1+).

tokens.name: kelp
tokens.usage: PacketSkipper's accent: its mark, its Dock tile when active, its app-bar underline. Fills and strokes only; never put text on it (use the -deep token for text).

tokens.name: kelp-deep
tokens.usage: PacketSkipper's accent as text or icon on paper (5:1+).

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: BallastBook's accent: its mark, its Dock tile when active, its app-bar underline. Fills and strokes only; never put text on it (use the -deep token for text).

tokens.name: cobalt-deep
tokens.usage: BallastBook's accent as text or icon on paper (5:1+).

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: ShipShape's accent: its mark, its Dock tile when active, its app-bar underline. Fills and strokes only; never put text on it (use the -deep token for text).

tokens.name: plum-deep
tokens.usage: ShipShape's accent as text or icon on paper (5:1+).

tokens.name: azure
tokens.usage: AboveBoard's accent: its mark, its Dock tile when active, its app-bar underline. Fills and strokes only; never put text on it (use the -deep token for text). 3.6:1 on paper by day, so never as text.

tokens.name: azure-deep
tokens.usage: AboveBoard's accent as text or icon on paper (5:1+): a deeper step of the same blue, not in the brand package, the same one the website shell uses.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Current, compliant, done. A teal, not a green, so it never sits on the red-green axis opposite status-danger. Always paired with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Expiring soon, due this week, needs review. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Expired, overdue, failed. Always paired with a word or icon. Differs from status-ok in lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: status-ok-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of an ok badge or row flag. Text on it is status-ok.

tokens.name: status-warn-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a warn badge or row flag. Text on it is status-warn.

tokens.name: status-danger-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a danger badge or row flag. Text on it is status-danger.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring on every interactive element: 2px solid, 2px offset. Meets 3:1 on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunken in both themes.

families.mono: var(--font-plex-mono, "IBM Plex Mono"), "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Page titles, the one big number on a dashboard. Never inside a table or card.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Section titles, empty-state headlines, dialog titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Sub-sections, table group headers, form fieldset legends.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The certificate on file lists the association as additional insured.
styles.usage: Default for everything: paragraphs, table cells, inputs, button labels.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Last reminder sent Tuesday to the vendor's billing contact.
styles.usage: Helper text, captions, table meta and secondary cells. Set in ink-muted unless it is the only text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Column headers, badges, field labels. Uppercase via CSS, never typed in caps.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Dates, policy limits, IDs, counts in tables and badges, anything that aligns in a column. Tabular by nature.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside buttons and inputs vertically; between stacked labels and fields.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; between controls in a toolbar.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; page gutter on phones; Dock tile size base.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards; section padding; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top of a page below the app bar; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, badges, table row selection, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, menus, Dock tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, large panels, the expanded Dock.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Avatars, the marks' containers, pill toggles. The ring in every mark is a circle; this radius echoes it.

shadow.note: Surfaces separate with hairline borders. Shadow exists only for things that float over the page.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts, dialogs. Nothing else.
